home.blurb: Become the sea, fly like seagulls and help Ariel bring a little lost boat home!

clip.line: Glowing fish light up the Coral Caves and swim beside the boat, all the way out to the island's beach.
clip.title: Through the Coral Caves

clip.caption: Welcome home!
clip.line: Ariel: Welcome home, {boat name}! Thank you, my waves and my seagulls. Whenever the sea washes up on the beach, listen closely. You'll hear it whisper the boat's name.
clip.title: Home at last

idle.line: Ariel: Flap, flap, flap! Up high like the seagulls!
idle.title: Keep flapping!

prompt.line: Ariel: The boat is moving, but it can't see where to go! The seagulls can show it the way. Flap your wings, everyone!
prompt.title: Flap like seagulls

clip.line: A flock of seagulls swoops up and circles over the boat, showing it the way home.
clip.title: The seagulls lead the way

clip.line: One brave little seagull flies out on its own and leads the boat onward.
clip.title: One brave seagull

clip.line: Ariel: Hello, friends! I'm Ariel, and I live on this magic island. Look! A little boat is lost far out at sea, with no sail and no captain. I can't bring it home by myself. Will you help me?
clip.title: A boat lost at sea

idle.line: Ariel: Whale or caves? I can't hear you!
idle.title: Ariel is waiting...

prompt.line: Ariel: There are two ways home. Should we sail past the Sleeping Whale, or through the Coral Caves? Shout it out, or vote on your phone!
prompt.title: Which way home?

timeout_clip.line: Ariel: Nobody chose? Then let's tiptoe past the whale!
timeout_clip.title: Ariel decides

idle.line: Ariel: Bigger waves! Swoosh, swoosh! The boat is starting to move!
idle.title: Bigger waves!

prompt.line: Ariel: The boat can only move if the sea moves. Can you all be the waves? Show me your best sea!
prompt.title: Become the sea

sea.question: Become the sea! Move like the waves!

clip.line: The waves rise and roll, and the little boat rocks closer to the island. Ariel: What a wonderful sea you make!
clip.title: The waves carry the boat

clip.line: Ariel whistles up a gentle wind, and the sea begins to roll. Ariel: There we go, the boat is moving!
clip.title: Ariel calls the wind

clip.line: The boat tiptoes past the giant sleeping whale... then the whale sneezes! Ah-CHOO! The splash pushes the boat all the way to the beach.
clip.title: Past the Sleeping Whale

calibration.message: Working. A couple more examples will make it more reliable.

title: Ariel and the Little Lost Boat
